3. Get t from useTranslationRef(techdocsTranslationRef) ('@backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha' and '../../../translation').

4. Render <TechDocsRedirectNotification key={formerEntityRef} message={t('redirectNotification.renamedFrom', { formerEntityRef })} actionLabel={t('redirectNotification.dismiss')} handleButtonClick={() => {}} autoHideDuration={15000} />, importing it from '../TechDocsRedirectNotification'.

behaviour: When the reader's entity lookup finds no entity, asks the optional former-ref lookup and on a hit replaces the URL with the same docs sub-path, query and anchor under the current entity, passing the former ref in location state.
rules: 1. Import useLocation alongside useNavigate from 'react-router-dom'.
2. Extend the TSDoc: the hook also follows entity renames declared through the backstage.io/former-names annotation; keep '@internal' and the existing params/returns wording.
3. Add const location = useLocation() after const navigate = useNavigate().

4. The useAsync callback returns { url: string; formerEntityRef?: string } | undefined. Inside the existing try: when the entity has the external annotation, build url with buildTechDocsURL(catalogEntity, viewTechdocLink) and return { url } when it is defined.

5. Still inside try: when catalogEntity is undefined and catalogApi.getEntityByFormerRef exists, call it with entityRef; on a hit compute newBase = buildTechDocsURL(current, viewTechdocLink) and oldBase = viewTechdocLink({ namespace: entityRef.namespace, kind: entityRef.kind, name: entityRef.name }); when newBase is defined set rest = location.pathname.startsWith(oldBase) ? location.pathname.slice(oldBase.length) : '' and return { url: `${newBase}${rest}${location.search}${location.hash}`, formerEntityRef: stringifyEntityRef(entityRef) }.
6. Keep the catch that ignores errors and the final return undefined; keep the dependency list [entityKey, catalogApi].

7. In the useEffect: when not loading and a value exists, call navigate(value.url, { replace: true, state: { formerEntityRef: value.formerEntityRef } }) when formerEntityRef is set, otherwise navigate(value.url, { replace: true }) exactly as today.
8. Keep the checkedEntityRef guard, shouldShowProgress formula and return shape unchanged (value truthiness still drives shouldShowProgress).
